about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque P200 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Evoque P200 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine introduced as part of Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family. It was first fitted to the L538-generation Evoque from 2016, before carrying over into the current L551 generation that launched in 2019. The AJ200P is the entry-level petrol option in the Evoque range, sitting below the higher-output P250 in the same engine family.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200P engines for every Range Rover Evoque P200 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque from 2016 to the present day, across both the L538 and L551 generations. Generally reliable as an engine family, with cooling system issues possible as with any modern high-output petrol unit. We replace timing chains, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the P200 uses a specific tuning of the Ingenium AJ200P family, we confirm the exact spec of your engine before quoting or fitting anything. We verify:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ200P) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
